title: Immune response to RSV in preterm and term infants
description: This study measured the cytokine, cellular and transcriptomic response to RSV and compared these between preterm and term infants CBMC responses Overall design: Comparison of the immune response to RSV stimulation in CBMCs from infants born preterm or term
